|errata_history={{Card errata/First Order Stormtrooper}}
This is errata version PC-E3 of [[First Order Stormtrooper (Virtual Set 4, Original)]] (version 4 of 5). The current text is [[First Order Stormtrooper (Remastered 2025)]] (PC-E4). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[First Order Stormtrooper (Virtual Set 4, Original)]]): Players Committee Virtual Card Slips Master List<ref name="eh1351-fost-0">Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222826id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/MasterList.pdf#page=24 Virtual Card Slips Master List], Set 4 Dark Side, PDF p. 24, middle column, First Order Stormtrooper full-face slip. Archived 6 August 2016.</ref>. Dated by 6 August 2016 (the earliest preserved copy of the Set 4 slip); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of First Order Stormtrooper (Virtual Set 4, Original) first published}} Virtual Set 4 was released on 29 June 2016. Text: “Deploys free to same site as a First Order leader. Opponent’s characters here are defense value -1 for each First Order stormtrooper here (limit -3).” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[First Order Stormtrooper]]): Players Committee “Current Erratas & Unlimited Shields”<ref name="eh1351-fost-1">Players Committee, [https://www.starwarsccg.org/current-erratas-unlimited-shields/ Current Erratas &amp; Unlimited Shields], 16 November 2016; the strikethrough identifies the clause deleted by the erratum.</ref>. First published 16 November 2016. Text: “Deploys free to same site as a First Order leader. Opponent's characters here are cumulatively defense value -1 (limit -3).” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “Opponent's”, “cumulatively”; words removed: “for each First Order stormtrooper here”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[First Order Stormtrooper (Errata)]]): Players Committee Competitive Balance announcement, effective immediately<ref name="eh1351-fost-2">Players Committee, [https://www.starwarsccg.org/competitive-balance-set-12-preview-cards-released/ Competitive Balance, Set 12 Preview Cards Released], 9 December 2019, effective immediately.</ref>. First published 9 December 2019. The PC card image with this text followed on 11 January 2021 (Holotable commit dc382c8); it still prints the mark “E”. Text: “Deploys -1 to same site as a First Order leader. Opponent's characters here are cumulatively defense value -1 (limit -3).” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “-1”. It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-fost-3">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/firstorderstormtrooper.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022).</ref>. First published 1 June 2022. Text: “Deploys -1 to same site as a First Order leader. Opponent's characters here are cumulatively defense value -1 (limit -3).” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”). It prints the errata mark “E1”.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[First Order Stormtrooper (Remastered 2025)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-fost-4">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/firstorderstormtrooper.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e commit 5637ac6] (12 December 2025).</ref>. First published 12 December 2025. Text: “Deploys -1 to same site as a First Order leader. Opponent's characters here are cumulatively defense value -1 (limit -3).” '''What changed:''' the words are the same. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
